target_lang_translations.de: Starke Regenfälle führten dazu, dass der <w>Grey</w> im letzten Winter über seine Ufer trat.
target_lang_translations.fr: L'hiver dernier, de fortes pluies ont provoqué la crue du <w>Grey</w>.

target_lang_translations.tr: Geçen kış şiddetli yağışlar <w>Grey</w> Nehri'nin taşmasına neden oldu.
target_lang_translations.es: Las fuertes lluvias hicieron que el río <w>Grey</w> se desbordara el invierno pasado.

senses.sense_definition: An English earldom or title of nobility.

examples.text: Earl <w>Grey</w> was a British Prime Minister after whom the tea is named.

examples.text: The title of <w>Grey</w> has been held by several prominent figures in British history.
